title: Scalar localization of a linear category at one element
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $\varpi\in R$, and let $R[1/\varpi]$ be the localization of $R$ at the multiplicative set $\{\varpi^n:n\geq0\}$, with its ring map $R\to R[1/\varpi]$ [def-weil-ring-localization-away]. (For $R=\mathcal O_E$ the valuation ring of a finite extension $E/\Ql$ and $\varpi=\varpi_E$ a uniformizer [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], $R[1/\varpi_E]=E$ [lem-weil-l-adic-integers-localization-uniformizer].) Let $\mathcal C$ be an $R$-linear category [def-weil-linear-category]: every $\Hom_{\mathcal C}(K,L)$ is an $R$-module and composition is $R$-bilinear. The *scalar localization* (*rationalization*) $\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$ is the category whose objects are those of $\mathcal C$, with

$$
 \Hom_{\mathcal C[1/\varpi]}(K,L)=\Hom_{\mathcal C}(K,L)\otimes_R R[1/\varpi],
$$

the base change of the $R$-module $\Hom_{\mathcal C}(K,L)$ along $R\to R[1/\varpi]$ [def-weil-module-base-change], composition the $R[1/\varpi]$-bilinear map induced by the $R$-bilinear composition of $\mathcal C$, $(f\otimes a)\circ(g\otimes b)=(f\circ g)\otimes ab$, and identities $\mathrm{id}_K\otimes1$; it is an $R[1/\varpi]$-linear category [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-category]. The *localization functor* $Q:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$ is the identity on objects and sends $f$ to $f\otimes1$; it is an $R$-linear functor [def-weil-linear-functor]. If $\mathcal C$ carries an automorphism $[1]$ (a shift) that is an $R$-linear functor, then $[1]$ induces the automorphism of $\mathcal C[1/\varpi]$ given by $K\mapsto K[1]$ and $f\otimes a\mapsto f[1]\otimes a$, and $Q\circ[1]=[1]\circ Q$ [lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-category].

split_report.summary: Checked against the master blueprint text of def-weil-rationalization-karoubi (the only source; Bhatt-Scholze's introduction gives the same rationalization for D^b_c(X,Q_l)); statement kept, with every notion now cited. Split by one level into four Mathlib leaves, def-weil-linear-category (CategoryTheory.Linear; Stacks 09MJ), def-weil-linear-functor (Functor.Additive + Functor.Linear; Stacks 09MK), def-weil-ring-localization-away (Localization.Away / IsLocalization.Away; Stacks 00CO), def-weil-module-base-change (LinearMap.baseChange, distribBaseChange for the induced bilinear map; Stacks 05G3), and two unsplit statements the definition needs: lem-weil-linear-scalar-localization-category (composition well defined, associative, unital, R[1/ϖ]-bilinear; Q an R-linear functor; the induced shift commutes with Q: the proofs the definition requires, per AGENTS.md §5) and lem-weil-l-adic-integers-localization-uniformizer (O_E[1/ϖ_E]=E, asserted parenthetically in the statement and used by def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, which writes Hom ⊗_{O_E} E). The shift hypothesis is phrased as an R-linear automorphism functor. Mathlib has no change of scalars for linear categories (W.Localization at {ϖ^n·id} keeps scalars R and does not identify Hom with Hom ⊗_R R[1/ϖ]).
